worldcombat.skill.aromatherapy.summary: Lays a lingering scent cloud at a chosen point: the user and allies standing in it have every harmful status effect repeatedly cleansed, and any status applied while it lasts is cleansed too; walking around the cloud avoids it.
worldcombat.skill.aromatherapy.use.0: Lay a cloud where allies hold or brawl
worldcombat.skill.aromatherapy.use.1: Pre-place the cloud on a path allies will take
worldcombat.skill.aromatherapy.use.2: Purge a whole clustered group with one cloud
worldcombat.skill.aromatherapy.descripti: Lays a %1$s-block scent cloud at the chosen point for %2$s; about every 0.25 s the cloud cleanses the user and allies inside of every harmful status effect (they need a clear line to the cloud's centre), and any status applied while it lasts is cleansed too.
worldcombat.skill.aromatherapy.stance.de: Dense: x0.75 radius, but x1.3 duration and a slightly slower wind-up (a tight, long-lasting cloud).
worldcombat.skill.aromatherapy.stance.di: Diffuse: x1.2 radius, faster wind-up and cooldown, but x0.85 duration (wide and short-lived).
worldcombat.skill.aromatherapy.timing: A point move: after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s, entering a %4$s s cooldown on cast; it cannot move while preparing or recovering, and can be interrupted.
worldcombat.skill.aromatherapy.preferenc: On: x0.75 radius but x1.3 duration and x1.15 wind-up. Off (diffuse): x1.2 radius, x0.9 wind-up, x0.95 cooldown, but x0.85 duration. Each direction has its moments.
The cloud is worth laying once at least this many allies (including itself) carry a status; 1 lays at the first case, higher waits for more to be caught together.
Allies within this distance count as being in the cloud; lower lays only when adjacent, higher for allies further out.
worldcombat.skill.aromatherapy.growth.0: From level %1$s, cooldown is reduced by an extra 1 seconds.
worldcombat.skill.aromatherapy.growth.1: From level %1$s, the extra cooldown reduction becomes 2.1 seconds, replacing the earlier reduction.
worldcombat.skill.aromatherapy.descripti: The cloud stays only while its caster does: if the caster falls or moves too far away, the cloud dissipates early.
